facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes, via NRB-licensed channels such as a bank's prepaid foreign-currency card.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes, for foreign-currency earners: banks open convertible foreign-currency accounts.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Khalti needs a registered business and PAN/VAT; individuals can't become merchants.
facts.L1_registration: Freelancers can use a Personal PAN; online sellers must also register on the DoCSCP portal.
facts.L2_tax_id: PAN from the Inland Revenue Department, free of charge.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Foreign income from software, consulting or content: 5% tax collected by the bank.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 13% VAT; services to clients abroad are zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: Individual Privacy Act 2075 applies; there is no data protection authority.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: E-Commerce Act 2081: show your PAN, address and a complaints process.
facts.L7_incentives: 5% tax on foreign income, and 50% off income tax for IT-service exporters.

watch_out.text: Card balances above USD 10,000 must move into your bank account.
Payoneer support for Nepal isn't confirmed on any Payoneer page.
Unlisted online sellers face fines up to Rs 200,000.
